package.name: omnihand_o10_model
package.description: Node-less version-locked OmniHand O10 model asset package. Loads and structurally validates the left/right generated URDF, left/right MJCF and provenance manifest from the ament install space (or an external read-only fixture path before the upstream license is confirmed). No runtime nodes. Upstream model assets are NOT vendored here pending license confirmation (see ADR-0007).
